this work is an outstanding example of how structural analysis of a macromolecular assembly, in combination with functional studies, can provide an unprecedented level of detail and mechanistic understanding of a complex biological system.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the structure of the type IV pilus (T4P)-secreton machinery has been solved in the closed state (as a whole) and in the open state (as individual subunits).
we determined the structure of the type IV pili machinery in the open state and the closed state by electron cryo-tomo graphy.

we have been able to visualize a type IV pilin machinery at the nanometer scale in situ in the cell.
we were able to determine the structure of a bacterial type IV pilus (T4P).
